info.description: Interactive OpenAPI 3.0 documentation for Scotty Starter, showcasing all Scotty capabilities.
info.title: Scotty Starter API

get.description: Fetches posts from SQLite with optional case-insensitive substring search via ?q=...

post.description: Inserts a new post record into SQLite and returns the created post with auto-increment ID.

delete.description: Removes the post record from SQLite by ID.

get.description: Queries SQLite for a post matching the primary key :id.

put.description: Updates the title of an existing post in SQLite.

get.description: Triggers ScottyExceptions (missing query, unparseable parameter) to demonstrate centralized error handlers.

post.description: Demonstrates extracting multipart form fields via S.formParam.

get.description: Demonstrates inspecting client headers, reading cookies, setting custom response headers, and setting cookies.
get.summary: Read and set HTTP headers and cookies

post.description: Demonstrates typed deserialization using Aeson FromJSON and S.jsonData.
